modifications: Rewritten as a bilingual portable photo-editing skill and ordered recipe, retaining the main-anchor, echo-fragment, geometric-interruption, scale-anomaly and media-degradation concepts.
Preserve the input aspect ratio instead of enforcing a 3:5 poster; 4:5 is only the catalog-example convention.
Preserve actual people count and complete groups, coherent anatomy and prop connections; separate flat repeated fragments from physical subjects.
Default to no text and include only user-supplied wording instead of inventing archive codes or pseudo-interface labels.
Remove provider-specific execution and local image-copy requirements; follow host authorization and project COS storage rules.
Add prompt-only behavior, explicit image-reference roles, localized acceptance criteria and truthful example status; do not redistribute upstream reference images.
